description: Row/column operations on a run of rows (dimension=ROWS) or columns (dimension=COLUMNS), addressed by sheet_id + 0-based start_index (inclusive) and end_index (exclusive) — e.g. columns A-C = start 0, end 3. action=resize sets an exact pixel_size; auto_resize fits to content; insert adds empty rows/columns at start_index (inherit_from_before=true copies formatting from the row/column before instead of after); delete removes them WITH their data (irreversible; cell references below/right shift); hide/show toggle visibility without touching data; group/ungroup add or remove a collapsible outline group over the run (groups nest — repeat group on a subrange for a deeper level).

action.description: What to do with the rows/columns.

dimension.description: Whether the run is rows or columns.

end_index.description: End of the run, exclusive (rows 1-3 = start 0, end 3).

inherit_from_before.description: insert: new rows/columns copy formatting from before the insertion point (default: after).

pixel_size.description: resize: the new size in pixels.

sheet_id.description: The numeric sheetId (NOT the title) from get_spreadsheet sheets[].properties.sheetId; the first sheet of a new spreadsheet is 0.

spreadsheet_id.description: The spreadsheet id — the long id from the URL (docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/<spreadsheetId>/edit) or from create_spreadsheet / search_spreadsheets output.

start_index.description: First row/column of the run, 0-based inclusive.

name: manage_dimensions
title: Manage rows and columns
